messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - Metering anomaly detected

incident-bot: Metric: billing.token_count_delta > 7% over 15m for emitters-prod region. Auto-threshold triggered. Link: https://redwood/ops/alerts/1718754321

ops-rotation: oncall here — investigating. Saw spike in token counts vs. expected in the last 10m. Resources: emitter service (emitter-prod), token-aggregator.

maya: looking at customer impact — any customers already hit overage email?

cs-team: @maya yes, we've seen 2 automated overage emails for acct: ACME-42 around 15:22 UTC. Customer reached out.

samir: running quick check on emitter retries. curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api/query?metric=emitter_retries&range=30m' | jq .

samir: last 30m retries jumped from ~200/h to ~5k/h starting 15:18

alesha: logs from emitter (tail):
```
[15:18:03] WARN: kafka consumer pause - GC pause 2.8s
[15:18:05] ERROR: duplicate message id=abcd1234 - ack timeout
[15:18:07] INFO: retrying emit for msg=abcd1234 attempt=1
```

jorge: looks like consumer paused -> producer retries -> duplicate token events. Could inflate counts.

lina: can we temporarily disable emitter auto-retry for riskier paths? Feature-flag exists: feature.disable_emitter_retries=true

ops-rotation: I can toggle the flag. Doing it now.

ops-rotation: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/flag/disable_emitter_retries -d '{"value":true}'` -> 200

incident-bot: NOTE: feature flag flip recorded by ops-rotation at 15:26 UTC

maya: CS has paused automated overage emails for affected accounts — outreach queued.

cs-team: created ticket CS-8492 and notified ACME-42. No billing charges applied yet per billing preview.

samir: restarted token-aggregator consumer on cluster k8s-emitter-3 (rolling restart). Restart started 15:28.

samir: restart completed 15:29. Retry rate dropped back to baseline within ~2m.

alesha: doing quick validation run: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM token_events WHERE hour='2026-02-10T15:00' AND source='emitter-prod';

alesha: small scan shows duplicate message ids count elevated for that hour; we should de-dup and run correction job.

ops-rotation: mitigation step summary: 1) flipped disable_emitter_retries flag, 2) restarted consumer, 3) paused overage emails. Baseline restored.

maya: customer impact: ACME-42 received alert but CS prevented charge; they want root cause and ETA for fix.

jorge: root cause hypothesis: long GC pause on emitter consumer led to unacked messages and producer retries, causing duplicate events. We'll create backfill pipeline to dedupe and correct counts.

lina: action items: 
- samir: implement dedupe-by-message-id job + backfill (ETA EOD)
- jorge: instrument per-message id metrics and alert (ETA tomorrow)
- ops-rotation: follow up with billing to revert any provisional charges (in progress)
- maya: send customer RCA draft (ETA 2h)

samir: starting dedupe job in dry-run mode to estimate correction volume.

samir: dry-run results: ~1.2% of tokens in window are duplicates -> estimated correction ~0.8% net delta on billing for affected accounts.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - mitigations applied, baseline restored, customer outreach in-flight. Status: monitoring :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks all. I'll keep CS post updated. Closing thread when backfill completes and invoices reconciled.

ops-rotation: marking incident for follow-up in postmortem queue: PM-INC-20260210

incident-bot: Incident closed by ops-rotation at 15:45 UTC (monitoring). :white_check_mark:
